summary: HPXPrinterDetails is a comprehensive Page Object Model class for Android mobile automation testing of HP printer functionality. It extends SmartFlow and implements the Page Object pattern with 39 methods covering printer operations including scanning, printing, copying, faxing, and device management. The class demonstrates advanced mobile automation patterns: (1) Swipe-to-find pattern with configurable max_swipes for scrollable UI elements, (2) Conditional element interaction with raise_e flag for flexible error handling, (3) Fallback click gestures using coordinates when element locators fail, (4) Verification methods for UI state validation, (5) Data extraction methods for retrieving printer information. All UI elements are referenced by string identifiers (locators) passed to driver methods, following a clean separation of locator definitions from page logic. The class supports comprehensive printer workflows from device setup to print job execution and status verification.
